patterns.message: An island entry graph must not import the SPA router or the workbook store — an island mounts with neither. The item stores are refused by the island build instead, which sees the graph after types are erased, so `import type` from them stays fine.

paths.name: vue-router
paths.message: The viewer graph must not depend on a router instance — an island mounts without one. Use helpers/navigation instead.

patterns.message: The viewer graph must not import the SPA router — it drags every routed page into the bundle and an island mounts without a router. Use helpers/navigation instead.

paths.name: vue-router
paths.message: The viewer graph must not depend on a router instance — an island mounts without one. Use helpers/navigation instead.

patterns.message: The item stores must not import the workbook store — the workbook is the builder's aggregate, and an island mounts an item with no builder around it. Workbook-coupled behaviour belongs in workbook/workbook_items.
